Name: Zoning, Studio 54 Rehabilitation and Text Amendment, Manhattan (N 260211 ZRM).
Title: Application number N 260211 ZRM (Studio 54 Rehabilitation and Text Amendment) submitted by Roundabout Theatre Company, pursuant to Section 201 of the New York City Charter, for an amendment of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York, amending the Theater Subdistrict provisions in Article VIII, Chapter 1 (Special Midtown District), including Section 81-744 (Transfer of development rights from listed theaters) and Section 81-745 (Floor area bonus for rehabilitation of existing listed theaters), Borough of Manhattan, Community District 5, Council District 3.

History.Description: This Land Use Application was Introduced by Council
This Land Use Application was Referred to Comm by Council to the Committee on Land Use
This Land Use Application was Referred to Comm by Council to the Subcommittee on Zoning and Franchises
